sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged In Sub Jail, Sanchore)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP 2. Sarifa Banu S/o Meethe Khan, R/o - Eta P.s. Dhanera,
 Dist. Banaskantha (Gujrat).
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Gulab Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 12/12/2024 1.

This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS (Section 439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.356/2024 registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Sanchore, for offences under Sections 450, 376(2)(n), 366, 120B and 506 of IPC.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that prosecutrix, who is a mature married woman voluntarily went away with the present petitioner from her matrimonial house on 11.06.2024.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the FIR and challan papers submitted by the Investigating Agency before the competent Criminal Court, learned counsel submitted that as per the prosecutrix,
she was subjected to forcible sexual assault by the petitioner about one year prior to the date of lodging of the FIR.

The petitioner also captured her obscene videos and [2024:RJ-JD:51089] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-13273/2024] photographs and thereafter, by threatening her to circulate them, he committed sexual assault upon her on multiple occasions.

As per the prosecutrix, on 11.06.2024, she Husain Khan vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:51089) on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188862644/
1 was forcibly abducted by the petitioner and co-accused persons and thereafter again subjected to sexual assault.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the FIR has been lodged against the petitioner on a totally false premise.

To substantiate this contention, attention of the Court was drawn towards the Missing Person's Report No.JJ/14/2024 lodged by the brother of the prosecutrix on 12.06.2024 at Police Station Dhanera, District Banaskantha (Gujrat)

, learned counsel submitted that pursuant to the aforesaid Missing Person's Report, when the prosecutrix was traced by the police officials, she made a statement that she had voluntarily went away with the present petitioner and has also solemnized marriage with him.

In the statements of the prosecutrix recorded pursuant to the Missing Person's Report No.JJ/14/2024, she has clearly denied the allegation of she being forcibly abducted or subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner.
Learned counsel submitted that material available on record clearly indicate that the petitioner has been roped in a false criminal case by the prosecutrix under the pressure of her family members.

5. Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody; the investigation against him has already been concluded and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
6. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

7. Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case and having perused the various documents placed on record including the Missing Person's Report No.JJ/14/2024 and the statements of the prosecutrix recorded by the police officials at (Gujarat) and the agreement signed by her expressing her intention to enter into live-in-relationship with the present petitioner,
and without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
8.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS (Section 439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused- petitioner Husain Khan S/o Suleman Khan arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.356/2024 registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Sanchore, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial Court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
9. It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial Court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 48-AnilKC/-
